+def _split_top(s):
+    parts, depth, cur, quote = [], 0, "", None
+    for ch in s:
+        if quote:
+            cur += ch
+            if ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+            continue
+        if ch in "'\"`":
+            quote = ch
+            cur += ch
+            continue
+        if ch == "(":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch == ")":
+            depth -= 1
+        if ch == "," and depth == 0:
+            parts.append(cur)
+            cur = ""
+        else:
+            cur += ch
+    parts.append(cur)
+    return [p.strip() for p in parts if p.strip()]
+
+
+def _projection_items(sql):
+    """Top-level SELECT list items, or None if not determinable."""
+    s = sql.strip()
+    m = re.match(r"(?is)^select\s+(distinct\s+|all\s+)?", s)
+    if not m:
+        return None
+    rest = s[m.end():]
+    depth = 0
+    quote = None
+    for i, ch in enumerate(rest):
+        if quote:
+            if ch == quote:
+                quote = None
+            continue
+        if ch in "'\"`":
+            quote = ch
+            continue
+        if ch == "(":
+            depth += 1
+        elif ch == ")":
+            depth -= 1
+        elif depth == 0 and re.match(r"(?i)from\b", rest[i:]) and (
+            i == 0 or not (rest[i - 1].isalnum() or rest[i - 1] == "_")
+        ):
+            return _split_top(rest[:i])
+    return None
+
+
+def _from_tables(sql):
+    """Table names appearing in the top-level FROM/JOIN clauses."""
+    names = []
+    for m in re.finditer(r"(?is)\b(?:from|join)\s+([\"'`\[]?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*[\"'`\]]?)", sql):
+        nm = m.group(1).strip("\"'`[]")
+        if nm.lower() not in ("select", "("):
+            names.append(nm)
+    return names
+
+
+def _named_attrs(question, hint, tabs, used_tables):
+    """Attributes the question explicitly asks to see (conservative)."""
+    q = (question or "").lower()
+    qwords = set(re.findall(r"[a-z_]+", q))
+    # words that appear only in the hint are filters/formulas, not projections
+    hwords = set(re.findall(r"[a-z_]+", (hint or "").lower()))
+    found = []
+    for t in used_tables:
+        for col in tabs.get(t, []):
+            cl = col.lower()
+            if cl in STOP:
+                continue
+            toks = [w for w in cl.replace("-", "_").split("_") if w]
+            if not toks:
+                continue
+            # full column name spoken verbatim
+            if cl in q and len(cl) > 2:
+                found.append((t, col))
+                continue
+            meaningful = [w for w in toks if w not in QUESTION_STOP and len(w) > 2]
+            if not meaningful:
+                continue
+            # every meaningful token must be spoken in the question
+            if all(w in qwords or (w.endswith("s") and w[:-1] in qwords) for w in meaningful):
+                # avoid matching filter-only vocabulary lifted from the hint
+                if all(w in hwords and w not in qwords for w in meaningful):
+                    continue
+                found.append((t, col))
+    # dedupe by column name, keep order
+    seen, out = set(), []
+    for t, c in found:
+        if c.lower() in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(c.lower())
+        out.append((t, c))
+    return out
+
+
+def _shape_issues(sql, res, question, hint, tabs):
+    """Return a list of human-readable shape problems (empty => looks fine)."""
+    issues = []
+    rows = res.get("rows") or []
+    cols = res.get("columns") or []
+    width = len(cols) if cols else (len(rows[0]) if rows else 0)
+    if not width:
+        return issues
+    used = [t for t in _from_tables(sql) if t in tabs]
+    uniq_used = list(dict.fromkeys(used))
+    ntab = len(uniq_used)
+    items = _projection_items(sql)
+    star = bool(items) and any(re.fullmatch(r"(?i)(?:[A-Za-z_0-9]+\.)?\*", it) for it in items)
+    attrs = _named_attrs(question, hint, tabs, uniq_used)
+    agg = bool(re.search(r"(?is)\b(count|sum|avg|min|max|total|group_concat)\s*\(", sql))
+    grouped = bool(re.search(r"(?is)\bgroup\s+by\b", sql))
+
+    # (a) explicit attribute list in the question but wrong width
+    if attrs and not agg and not grouped:
+        want = len(attrs)
+        if width != want and want <= 8:
+            names = ", ".join("%s.%s" % (t, c) for t, c in attrs)
+            issues.append(
+                "The question explicitly names %d attribute(s) (%s) but your query returns %d "
+                "column(s). Select exactly those attributes, in the order the question lists "
+                "them, and nothing else." % (want, names, width)
+            )
+
+    # (b) no attribute named: width should follow the table scope
+    if not attrs and not agg and not grouped:
+        vague = bool(
+            re.search(
+                r"(?i)\b(details?|information|info|records?|everything|all about|which|what|"
+                r"who|list|show|find|give)\b",
+                question or "",
+            )
+        )
+        if vague:
+            if ntab == 1 and star and width > 1:
+                t = uniq_used[0]
+                cand = [c for c in tabs[t] if c.lower() not in STOP]
+                issues.append(
+                    "The question names no specific attribute and touches a single table, yet "
+                    "you returned all %d columns via *. A reference answer for such a question "
+                    "usually projects the ONE column that identifies/answers the entity "
+                    "(e.g. the text/name/title/description column being asked about). Re-read "
+                    "the question and project only the column it is actually about; candidate "
+                    "columns of %s: %s." % (width, t, ", ".join(cand[:12]))
+                )
+            elif ntab >= 2 and not star and width < sum(len(tabs[t]) for t in uniq_used):
+                total = sum(len(tabs[t]) for t in uniq_used)
+                issues.append(
+                    "The question asks WHICH entities satisfy a condition across %d joined "
+                    "tables and names no specific attribute, but you projected only %d "
+                    "column(s). For such questions the reference typically returns the full "
+                    "joined rows: use SELECT * over the same FROM/JOIN (expected about %d "
+                    "columns) instead of a single name column." % (ntab, width, total)
+                )
+
+    # (c) join fan-out duplicates on an entity list
+    if ntab >= 2 and rows and not grouped:
+        keys = [tuple("" if v is None else str(v) for v in r) for r in rows]
+        if len(set(keys)) < len(keys) and not re.search(r"(?is)\bselect\s+distinct\b", sql):

+                "Your result contains duplicate rows produced by the join fan-out. If the "
+                "question asks for a list of entities (one row per entity), add DISTINCT or "
+                "restructure with EXISTS/IN so each entity appears once."
+            )
+    return issues

proposal.root_cause: Result-shape blindness: drafts that execute with rows are shipped unchecked, so wrong projection width (star vs named attributes vs full join row) and join fan-out duplicates survive
proposal.what: Add an execution-grounded shape audit to solve.py: estimate expected column count from attributes explicitly named in the question and the number of tables in FROM/JOIN, flag SELECT * / narrow-list mismatches and duplicate rows on multi-table entity lists, and trigger the existing second-call repair with the observed rows plus a precise projection/DISTINCT instruction.
